one_line: Online accounting software with a very broad REST API covering accounting, payroll, files, projects, bank feeds, and assets.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 with scopes via the Xero developer portal; app registration (private/public/partner) required. Requires a Xero organisation (free trial then paid) to access real data; some scopes need additional approval.
self_serve_notes: App registration is self-serve and the sandbox is free; a Xero trial/paid organisation is required for live data, and certain scopes are gated behind approval.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: 1000+ endpoints across Accounting API, Payroll (AU/NZ/UK/US), Files, Projects, Assets, Bank Feeds, and Xero HQ.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported with event categories and signed payloads.

existing_mcp.note: Community MCP servers for Xero exist; no official MCP published by Xero.

evidence.note: No fetched text file existed for this app; facts from domain knowledge. Docs URL confirmed reachable via curl.

agent_notes: OAuth flow well-documented; friction is app registration plus paid/trial organisation and scope approvals.
